title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 321 South 1st Street in Montrose, Colorado, as the Sergeant David Kinterknecht Post Office.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 321 South 1st Street in Montrose, Colorado, as the "Sergeant David Kinterknecht Post Office."

summary.headline: This law names a Postal Service facility in Montrose, Colorado, after Sergeant David Kinterknecht.
summary.what_it_does: The law renames the post office at 321 South 1st Street in Montrose, Colorado, as the Sergeant David Kinterknecht Post Office. It is an honorary designation that does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 21, 2020.
